findings.text: The status file says that `tests/conformance_insert_queries_test.py` checks the indexed transfer in `insert-query-transfer-column-list`, but SQLite uses its transfer optimization only for an INSERT with no column list; `INSERT INTO t(a) SELECT a FROM s` allocates new rowids, and the test only checks that the case stays `MODEL_UNSUPPORTED` (its output reads only `a`). Fix: Cite only `insert-query-transfer-with-rowid-gap` as the indexed-transfer case, or say that `insert-query-transfer-column-list` is the column-list boundary that the model also reports as unsupported.
